data.name: Garaji
data.detailed_description:
Garaji is a dungeon crawler where instead of goblins and trolls you fight hooligans, bandits and other representatives of the lower strata of society. The familiar dungeon corridors are replaced by garage co-ops, parking lots and metro stations. And magic items are replaced by bats, rebar and empty broken bottles. This is a rough and terrifying place where only cruelty will help you survive your adventure. The game is not made for casual players and requires an understanding of the genre and an analytical mindset.

Key Features

  • Party RPG

  • Grid-based movement

  • Turn-based encounter combat

data.short_description: Dungeon crawler about hooligans and bandits set in post-Soviet outskirts. Classic grid-based movement and turn-based combat. An ocean of blood and violence.
